text: Update: I removed and reinstalled the app and when I logged back in ALL of my comments were gone.
review: Doesn't sync. Update: I removed and reinstalled the app and when I logged back in ALL of my comments were gone. Content ideas there but every detail in the comments was wiped clean. The app is good so I don't forget content ideas and instion for said content, but sometimes I'm on my phone and I put it in the app here and most of the time it doesn't translate to my notion app on my Mac. I'll open and close on both ends but it only keeps the stuff I put in the first day i open the account. SOMETIMES info will show up on both, but usually not and I have to type it in again on my mac or on my phone so I can see everything I have input.

text: I'm glad I can use notion on iPad, but man... I use this for simple writing, google docs level stuff, and this app has a lot off issues.
review: I'm glad I can use notion on iPad, but man... I use this for simple writing, google docs level stuff, and this app has a lot off issues. I'm using the official iPad keyboard, and it's absolutely awful with clicking. It's hard to explain, but I feel I have to stop moving and click HARD every time I want to to start typing. And now since the new update, it just straight up doesn't work. I click, the type line appears, then it unselects itself. I have to click several times, eventually it works. That's awful. Fix that please. Another issue, the little taskbar is awful on iPad, I can't move it around or out of the way with a swipe, I have no idea how to change the colour of text effectively since when I open that menu it's hell to go back. There's more, and after using this app for a year I can probably raise a lot more issues and I reckon they'd be fixed - Notion seems like a great company and they've made a fantastic product. But it almost seems like these issues have gone unnoticed? Perhaps low on priority? ... if you can sort these sooner rather than later, that'd be very appreciated. Thanks for your time.

This is more than a Chatbot, it's a thinking/writing/doing partner!

text: I know this app has almost 70k mostly good reviews but I simply cannot get it to do the most basic of what it is meant to do, which is build a database.
review: Doesn't work. At all. I know this app has almost 70k mostly good reviews but I simply cannot get it to do the most basic of what it is meant to do, which is build a database. I'm not tech incompetent at all, even though I started questioning that fact after so much frustration when getting started. Am I just missing something?! The backslash does. Not. Work. I tried on the app. I tried in the browser. I made sure the / is not a \ and that I'm not entering it in a forbidden field or table. I watched all the videos. They all start with "type /database". I did. Which resulted in a "/database" appearing when I type and that's it!!! No menu! No options!! I tried Reddit. I tried YouTube. I tried the official Notion tutorial. Pointless because I cannot create anything when typing a backslash. Why should I trust this program when your GUI is the most counterintuitive app I've ever used? Thank god I don't have to use this for work. I wanted to build a plant database and spent so much time trying to figure this out that I could have typed in and redo the entire database by hand for all the time I spent using this stupid app. I've created and deleted my account twice now, because the first time I deleted it out of frustration, I tried it again because I couldn't accept that it did not work for me when it did for everyone else. But I'm done attempting and trying airtable

العراق. اعطيت التطبيق نجمة واحدة لكوني لم استطع استخدامه او تجربته! بسبب مشكلة اتجاه النص العربي (RTL) و بسبب عدم توفّر واجهة عربية (Arabic UI)، و في ادناه تحليل المشكلة و الحل الذي ينبغي على المطورين اعتماده. - وصف المشكلة (Issue Description):. يعاني المستخدمون العرب من قلب اتجاه السطر وتخبّط المحاذاة أثناء الكتابة بالعربية داخل نَوشَن (Notion). يظهر الخلل خصوصًا عند إدراج كلمات إنجليزية قصيرة داخل سطر عربي، مما يؤدي إلى اضطراب اتجاه النص وعدم اتساق العرض. - خطوات إعادة الإنتاج (Steps to Reproduce):. 1. اكتب سطرًا عربيًا يبدأ بحرف عربي. 2. أضف مصطلحًا إنجليزيًا بين قوسين بعد كلمة عربية مثل: اسمي احمد (ahmed) وأسكن بغداد (Baghdad). 3. لاحظ تغيّر اتجاه السطر أو اختلاط المحاذاة يمينًا ويسارًا، خاصة عند نسخ السطر أو تعديله. - النتيجة الحالية (Actual Result):. اختلال اتجاه السطر وتخبّط المحاذاة، مما يصعّب القراءة والكتابة ويشوّه التنسيق. - النتيجة المتوقعة (Expected Result):. ثبات اتجاه النص العربي من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL) حتى مع وجود مصطلحات إنجليزية قصيرة ضمن السطر، مع محاذاة مستقرة وموثوقة. - الأثر (Impact):. تجربة الكتابة للمستخدم العربي تتأثر سلبًا، ويصعب استخدام نَوشَن (Notion) لإدارة المحتوى اليومي أو الاحترافي. هذا يسبب إحباطًا ويجبر البعض على التوقف عن استخدام التطبيق. - البيئة (Environment):. لغة الكتابة العربية (Arabic). المشكلة تظهر في الويب (Web) وتطبيق الهاتف (Mobile App) على حد سواء بحسب ملاحظات المستخدمين. - أمثلة سطرية (Examples):. - اسمي احمد (ahmed) وأسكن بغداد (Baghdad). - سكربت الحلقة (Script) والعناصر الأساسية (Key Points). - طلب التحسين (Request):. 1. دعم كامل لاتجاه النص العربي من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL) داخل المحرّر. 2. إضافة خيار لغة عربية للواجهة (Arabic UI) ضمن الإعدادات (Settings). 3. تحسين التعامل مع المصطلحات الإنجليزية القصيرة داخل السطور العربية دون إفساد الاتجاه. - ملاحظات إضافية (Additional Notes):. يفضّل توفير إعداد لإجبار اتجاه الفقرة عربيًا عند الحاجة، وخيار تنسيق سريع يضمن عدم قلب الاتجاه حتى مع الرموز والروابط.

العراق. اعطيت التطبيق نجمة واحدة لكوني لم استطع استخدامه او تجربته! بسبب مشكلة اتجاه النص العربي (RTL) و بسبب عدم توفّر واجهة عربية (Arabic UI)، و في ادناه تحليل المشكلة و الحل الذي ينبغي على المطورين اعتماده. - وصف المشكلة (Issue Description):. يعاني المستخدمون العرب من قلب اتجاه السطر وتخبّط المحاذاة أثناء الكتابة بالعربية داخل نَوشَن (Notion). يظهر الخلل خصوصًا عند إدراج كلمات إنجليزية قصيرة داخل سطر عربي، مما يؤدي إلى اضطراب اتجاه النص وعدم اتساق العرض. - خطوات إعادة الإنتاج (Steps to Reproduce):. 1. اكتب سطرًا عربيًا يبدأ بحرف عربي. 2. أضف مصطلحًا إنجليزيًا بين قوسين بعد كلمة عربية مثل: اسمي احمد (ahmed) وأسكن بغداد (Baghdad). 3. لاحظ تغيّر اتجاه السطر أو اختلاط المحاذاة يمينًا ويسارًا، خاصة عند نسخ السطر أو تعديله. - النتيجة الحالية (Actual Result):. اختلال اتجاه السطر وتخبّط المحاذاة، مما يصعّب القراءة والكتابة ويشوّه التنسيق. - النتيجة المتوقعة (Expected Result):. ثبات اتجاه النص العربي من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL) حتى مع وجود مصطلحات إنجليزية قصيرة ضمن السطر، مع محاذاة مستقرة وموثوقة. - الأثر (Impact):. تجربة الكتابة للمستخدم العربي تتأثر سلبًا، ويصعب استخدام نَوشَن (Notion) لإدارة المحتوى اليومي أو الاحترافي. هذا يسبب إحباطًا ويجبر البعض على التوقف عن استخدام التطبيق. - البيئة (Environment):. لغة الكتابة العربية (Arabic). المشكلة تظهر في الويب (Web) وتطبيق الهاتف (Mobile App) على حد سواء بحسب ملاحظات المستخدمين. - أمثلة سطرية (Examples):. - اسمي احمد (ahmed) وأسكن بغداد (Baghdad). - سكربت الحلقة (Script) والعناصر الأساسية (Key Points). - طلب التحسين (Request):. 1. دعم كامل لاتجاه النص العربي من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL) داخل المحرّر. 2. إضافة خيار لغة عربية للواجهة (Arabic UI) ضمن الإعدادات (Settings). 3. تحسين التعامل مع المصطلحات الإنجليزية القصيرة داخل السطور العربية دون إفساد الاتجاه. - ملاحظات إضافية (Additional Notes):. يفضّل توفير إعداد لإجبار اتجاه الفقرة عربيًا عند الحاجة، وخيار تنسيق سريع يضمن عدم قلب الاتجاه حتى مع الرموز والروابط.

العراق. اعطيت التطبيق نجمة واحدة لكوني لم استطع استخدامه او تجربته! بسبب مشكلة اتجاه النص العربي (RTL) و بسبب عدم توفّر واجهة عربية (Arabic UI)، و في ادناه تحليل المشكلة و الحل الذي ينبغي على المطورين اعتماده. - وصف المشكلة (Issue Description):. يعاني المستخدمون العرب من قلب اتجاه السطر وتخبّط المحاذاة أثناء الكتابة بالعربية داخل نَوشَن (Notion). يظهر الخلل خصوصًا عند إدراج كلمات إنجليزية قصيرة داخل سطر عربي، مما يؤدي إلى اضطراب اتجاه النص وعدم اتساق العرض. - خطوات إعادة الإنتاج (Steps to Reproduce):. 1. اكتب سطرًا عربيًا يبدأ بحرف عربي. 2. أضف مصطلحًا إنجليزيًا بين قوسين بعد كلمة عربية مثل: اسمي احمد (ahmed) وأسكن بغداد (Baghdad). 3. لاحظ تغيّر اتجاه السطر أو اختلاط المحاذاة يمينًا ويسارًا، خاصة عند نسخ السطر أو تعديله. - النتيجة الحالية (Actual Result):. اختلال اتجاه السطر وتخبّط المحاذاة، مما يصعّب القراءة والكتابة ويشوّه التنسيق. - النتيجة المتوقعة (Expected Result):. ثبات اتجاه النص العربي من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL) حتى مع وجود مصطلحات إنجليزية قصيرة ضمن السطر، مع محاذاة مستقرة وموثوقة. - الأثر (Impact):. تجربة الكتابة للمستخدم العربي تتأثر سلبًا، ويصعب استخدام نَوشَن (Notion) لإدارة المحتوى اليومي أو الاحترافي. هذا يسبب إحباطًا ويجبر البعض على التوقف عن استخدام التطبيق. - البيئة (Environment):. لغة الكتابة العربية (Arabic). المشكلة تظهر في الويب (Web) وتطبيق الهاتف (Mobile App) على حد سواء بحسب ملاحظات المستخدمين. - أمثلة سطرية (Examples):. - اسمي احمد (ahmed) وأسكن بغداد (Baghdad). - سكربت الحلقة (Script) والعناصر الأساسية (Key Points). - طلب التحسين (Request):. 1. دعم كامل لاتجاه النص العربي من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL) داخل المحرّر. 2. إضافة خيار لغة عربية للواجهة (Arabic UI) ضمن الإعدادات (Settings). 3. تحسين التعامل مع المصطلحات الإنجليزية القصيرة داخل السطور العربية دون إفساد الاتجاه. - ملاحظات إضافية (Additional Notes):. يفضّل توفير إعداد لإجبار اتجاه الفقرة عربيًا عند الحاجة، وخيار تنسيق سريع يضمن عدم قلب الاتجاه حتى مع الرموز والروابط.

text: great for organisation but paywalls & ai are annoying.
review: great for organisation but paywalls & ai are annoying. As a high school student who struggles with time management and organisation, I can say Notion is great for helping me stay on track, remember everything I need to do, and the layout of pages within pages, databases, embeds, toggles, etc are really useful for organisation. I also like to use notion for personal organisation outside of school with my friends, so being able to collaborate is nice. However the collaboration process is a little complicated and annoying sometimes. However, paywalls make the experience restrictive, and I understand the need for funding everything from the business point of view but what's annoying is once I run out of "blocks", deleting them and even emptying out my trash doesn't change it so I could delete everything and still not be able to do anything else with my workspace, forcing me to make yet another account. AI is also just straight up so horrible for the environment because of the amount of water and electricity it uses, and it promotes anti-intellectualism because users become dependent on it for writing, thinking, and making decisions, to the point it's affecting education all over the world. It also promotes anti-social behaviour and has been used in harmful (and on occasion illegal) ways. I hope you as a company take my experience into account as a user of four years to improve your app.

text: Fix Some Features.
review: Fix Some Features. I got recommended Notion for documents and images. The good thing about Notion is that when viewing images, you can zoom in perfectly and the image is not compressed in any way. I used this feature for a good while, and I always found it useful. But, recently, after the new updates, the process has gotten a little bit tedious when captioning images, as the three dots are no longer there at the top-right corner of the image so you can easily select the "Caption" option instead of holding on the image to do so. I really preferred the three-dots option. Also, when captioning an image, it causes the app to bug out, not allowing you scroll while editing the caption. This bug has frustrated me so much. And lastly, when wanting to view an image directly, you used to be able to just tap on the image to view it. But, now you have to hold the image and press "View Original." That's just too cumbersome and tedious to keep doing over and over again. I want to be able to view images right away. To summarize:. - The three-dots at the top right of each image was always very useful to quickly use other options such as captioning, but now its gone. I want it back. - When captionning, does not allow you to scroll for some reason. This is very annoying. - You cannot view images directly anymore, you need to hold to view. I want these features changed for a better experience on Notion. This update was right outright awful, and I really hope you guys notice these problems and please fix them. Thank you for acknowledging, I sure hope you fixed these problems.

But, recently, after the new updates, the process has gotten a little bit tedious when captioning images, as the three dots are no longer there at the top-right corner of the image so you can easily select the "Caption" option instead of holding on the image to do so. I really preferred the three-dots option. Also, when captioning an image, it causes the app to bug out, not allowing you scroll while editing the caption. This bug has frustrated me so much. And lastly, when wanting to view an image directly, you used to be able to just tap on the image to view it. But, now you have to hold the image and press "View Original." That's just too cumbersome and tedious to keep doing over and over again. I want to be able to view images right away. To summarize:. - The three-dots at the top right of each image was always very useful to quickly use other options such as captioning, but now its gone. I want it back. - When captionning, does not allow you to scroll for some reason. This is very annoying. - You cannot view images directly anymore, you need to hold to view. I want these features changed for a better experience on Notion. This update was right outright awful, and I really hope you guys notice these problems and please fix them. Thank you for acknowledging, I sure hope you fixed these problems.

text: Great, and still... There's a lot of things I like about Notion.
review: Great, and still... There's a lot of things I like about Notion. I've used it for years now, and really see its benefits. And, it needs work. The AI integrations can be obnoxious, like when you're trying to upload photos and you accidentally hit the new button they've added for AI notes. It takes forever to figure out how to get it off the screen. Uploading photos in general is sometimes a liability. If something happens to the connection, photos you think are almost uploaded stop midway and can't be recovered—so if you're taking photos directly into Notion which is how we want to use it, it may not save them. If you do upload them and need to download them, something recently changed where it takes extra steps to just get to the photo to do so. I guess my primarily complaint is not being able to trust Notion with managing my photos—which is crucial for our business and how we use Notion.

text: Best-in-Class Note-Taking and Organization Tool.
review: Best-in-Class Note-Taking and Organization Tool. Notion is hands-down the best note-taking app I've used (compared to Google Keep, Apple Notes, MS OneNote, etc.) It's beautifully designed, fast, and incredibly flexible. You can keep everything organized with pages inside pages, and the database feature takes things to another level — perfect for tracking projects, tasks, or anything you want to structure your way. It's more than just notes — it's a full workspace that adapts to how you think and work. Once you get used to it, it's hard to imagine going back to anything else. Phone support could get a little loving, but all in all an excellent offering.

text: Unusable with magic keyboard on iPad.
review: Unusable with magic keyboard on iPad. Notion is my go-to app on desktop however the app has a horrible bug where I'm unable to type using the magic keyboard on my iPad rendering the entire app unusable. This has been an issue for over a year now and it's really bothering me that they ignore the core UX in favour of implementing premium features like AI. It would be a full 5 starts if you fix this bug because as it stands I can't work while travelling

text: Locked out for having an air 2 despite not deleting my app.
review: Locked out for having an air 2 despite not deleting my app. I'm always so careful not to delete any of my apps due to the stupid and unnecessary forced update system. I tried to open my notion today and it wouldn't even let me log in, saying I needed the new iOS update. I clearly don't, the app worked fine before and so does my device. When this is a vital app for people and you have the option to let people who don't want to update the app be AND the option to not update lock the app, but you do the opposite of both, your corporate greed and inconsideration for your users shows.

text: Notion is an exceptional productivity app that excels in every aspect of modern digital workspace management.
review: Outstanding. Notion is an exceptional productivity app that excels in every aspect of modern digital workspace management. Usability: Notion is remarkably intuitive, with a seamless drag‐and‐drop interface and flexible page structure that makes organizing notes, tasks, and databases effortless. Even new users can quickly navigate and build workflows without a steep learning curve. Performance: The app runs smoothly across devices, with lightning‐fast syncing between desktop, mobile, and web. Pages load quickly, and even large databases or complex dashboards maintain consistent responsiveness. Design: Its minimalist, clean, and elegant design enhances focus without distractions. Subtle typography, spacing, and colour options let users create aesthetically pleasing layouts while maintaining clarity. Features: Notion offers a powerful all‐in‐one toolkit: collaborative workspaces, relational databases, kanban boards, calendars, wikis, AI assistance, and extensive templates. The flexibility to customise every page for personal or team needs makes it stand out. Value: With its robust free plan and versatile paid options, Notion delivers exceptional value for individuals, students, and businesses alike. It replaces multiple apps, effectively reducing costs and streamlining workflows. Overall, Notion sets the standard for productivity and organisation, offering a versatile and beautifully designed platform that empowers users to work smarter and more creatively.

text: Project Management A+/Excellent AI Tools.
review: Project Management A+/Excellent AI Tools. I have used several tools to try and manage projects (Monday, Excel, Google Docs, etc.) and Notion is by far the best. And the AI integration is the best AI I've ever used, as it trains first on data that you tell it then supplements it with outside information. And it can also build pages for you, so if you want a project management page with 3 different attributes and 20 different items, you spend 5 minutes printing the AI and it's done for you in seconds. And since it learns on your data, it's accurate to your data, not accurate to AI slop.

text: Good app, constant bugs.
review: Good app, constant bugs. I really enjoy using Notion on the desktop to organize writing projects and reading lists. But I've been using the mobile app for about two years, and for those two years it's been plagued with visual glitches, crashes, and syncing errors. Every new update fixes a bug and creates another. At time of writing, the button to close the keyboard leaves behind a giant black bar right in the middle of the screen. When you read this in the future, there might be another annoying bug. I rarely write reviews, but Notion is truly a great piece of software and it is really disappointing that the mobile version is so chronically janky.

text: Breadcrumb Feature Deprecation.
review: Breadcrumb Feature Deprecation. The iOS 26 design update removed breadcrumbs (page navigation) from the top of a page and placed it under the more options menu. Breadcrumbs are a core part of UX and aid in accessibility. They tell us where we are. Add them back to the top of the page so users don't have to click an extra two buttons just to see the breadcrumb list. Additionally, the breadcrumb block on mobile is odd. If you add it to a page it just shows you the name of your current page until you tap on it. It should show the breadcrumb list; use "..." like you used to if you have to.

text: Notion okay on desktop but terrible on iPad and even worse on iphone.
review: Notion okay on desktop but terrible on iPad and even worse on iphone. If you have more than one workspace and only one of them with AI none of the shortcuts work well or consistently. Deep linking is a disaster, and don't bother trying to edit pages as it is virtually impossible. iPhone SE won't let me tap on some controls, it's like they haven't even tested on the smaller screen. The AI just makes up answers about how the app is supposed to work. All in all a very frustrating experience on iOS but okay on desktop.

text: Becoming unusable recently.
review: Becoming unusable recently. I have a button in a page that will create the same block of bullet point list. It's a simple structure with a few bullet pints and date. I use the doc as a diary to keep track of what I do everyday. Recently, whenever I opens the page, the button starts to reload and page starts to refresh for more times than I am patient enough to wait. It could be that the page size is too big. However, I think the App should do a better job in caching or pagination. There might be some form of page structure where the entire data has to be fetched before it could load the page. But in my case, it will be a better customer experience if the head of the page is fetched. And when the app fetches the remaining content of the file, it does not force reload and refresh the page.

But in my case, it will be a better customer experience if the head of the page is fetched. And when the app fetches the remaining content of the file, it does not force reload and refresh the page.

text: Loads of potential, partly realized.
review: Loads of potential, partly realized. I've only used Notion for about a year (coming from Coda) but I've enjoyed the ease of use and aesthetic. The mobile app is a bit clunky and missing some functionality. For instance, there doesn't appear to be a way to edit a links properties in the mobile version. If you click on the property, it takes you to the linked site. If you press and hold, you have the option of opening the link, copying the link, or sharing the link. No way to delete or edit. And the inability to move to a new line within a text property is killing the functionality of this app as a note taking tool for me. You cannot move columns or adjust property positions in the app. Just three examples of simple functionality that seems to have been overlooked by Notion. The app gets very unstable sometimes, especially the filters. Almost every time I use an advanced filter, the app freezes and I have to force reset.

text: Piece of Junk.
review: Piece of Junk. Notion's executives like to describe this app as Lego bricks for productivity where you can build anything to get the job done. Well the truth is it's a whole lot more like a Lego knockoff where each piece is of shoddy quality and none of them fit together quite right. To do list check boxes, bullet points, heading formats, colors, highlighters, and basically any other formatting feature all frequently fail to do anything when a button is pressed. I have had to restart this app more than any other on my phone because of sheer sloppiness and laziness on the part of the development team. Avoid this app like the plague.

Previous review: I am on the most expensive plan with AI. I use this occasionally but its very helpful for those few days. Well today everything AI generates disappears. POOF. I thought this app was supposed to be reliable now it won't "hold" your subscription for more than 15 seconds. I downgraded only to get the notification that prices are more than quadrupling. You now can't even access AI except on a business plan which used to require more than one person and was twenty per person. Im done with this greedy app.

text: Too much forcing of AI.
review: Too much forcing of AI. I've been a paying user for a long time. Maybe ten years. Over the past few, Notion has shoved AI down their users throats. Everywhere. They don't care if you want it or not. It's just too much. Now, even as a paying user, you can't actually get a human for support. They filter all their support requests through an AI bot and if you try to get a human, you can't. I didn't sign up to pay for that. I paid to be able to get a human when I run into issues. So I've cancelled my subscription. They've gone too far and destroyed what used to be a great product.

text: It is flexible and easy to use.
review: So flexible. It is flexible and easy to use. Great value. The current Achilles heel in 12/2025 is two things: 1) the way you navigate creating and viewing relationships between records of related database entities. The interface is messy, unfilterable, and unreadable with any reasonable collection of related records. 2) The lack of segregation of records through ownership. You always see everybody's stuff. This is most problematic in related record lookups.

text: Love Notion, just needs better font accessibility.
review: Love Notion, just needs better font accessibility. I love Notion and use it every day to keep track of pretty much everything, favorite books, planning, notes, and long-term ideas. It's incredibly flexible and powerful. My only real issue is accessibility. There's no good way to increase font size, and it doesn't fully respect system text settings, which can make it hard to use comfortably. Fixing font accessibility would make this app close to perfect.

text: Some elbow grease requires.
review: Ultimate flexibility. Some elbow grease requires. Notion in a word - flexible. Simplicity. Probably not. That's not a criticism. That's testament to how much you can do with it. A file manager is simple. Make some folders, store some files. Search them. Useful? Yes. Powerful? Not really. Flexible. No. It's got a singular purpose. Notion is flexible and powerful. The trade off is knowing where to start. Notion can be a workflow tool. It can be a blog hosting platform. It can manage projects. Organise data for you and tag it. Be a research vault, holding articles, audio, imagery and video, all tailored and presented just the way you like it. Not a flat structure of files. No, think a rich webpage with links passing to other pages, embedded media. The works. And it's not that hard to get any of it working. Notion does a lot to make this as easy as it can be. It's all GUI driven. It's impressive. Sure it has quirks. Could you get something this flexible to work without them? Probably not. You will struggle to find a product as feature rich. Its AI tooling isn't just a gimmick either. It can truely help you manage and create content. Ask yourself - do you need this much in a tool? If you need a fantastic collaboration platform; a place to collect and organise your research project; a project management tool to help run your SMB; a way to effectively manage you local soccer club - notion could be your answer. If you just want somewhere to save your photos, or store some files, it's overkill. Overall an excellent product in the right context.

text: Truly Outstanding in Many Ways.
review: Truly Outstanding in Many Ways. I have been using Notion since 2018. It is unbelievably versatile to organize information, your life, your work, whatever YOU want to make it. The company continually innovates. I really appreciate the integration of AI, which for me makes searching for info in my Notion account (nearly 20,000 pages!) SO much easier, using natural language searches. With version 3.0 and the integration of AI agents it is a massive game changer. And I also appreciate the fact the company has kept Notion so affordable (unlike their competitors). I rarely rate anything 5 stars, but Notion is definitely worth it!

text: A must have for organization.
review: A must have for organization. I'm very pleased with Notion. I've been using it for a few months now, and can confidently say that my organization at work has increased substantially. My favorite feature is simply how customizable it is. You can build just about any organizational tool without being a computer scientist, allowing it to fit any need one may have. The customer service is also outstanding. I emailed in with a small issue that was frankly my fault and they went above and beyond to ensure I was happy, responding in well under 24 hours.

My favorite feature is simply how customizable it is. You can build just about any organizational tool without being a computer scientist, allowing it to fit any need one may have. The customer service is also outstanding. I emailed in with a small issue that was frankly my fault and they went above and beyond to ensure I was happy, responding in well under 24 hours.

text: App is completely broken on iPad.

It affects the overlays when you click to view pages within databases. Overall very annoying to use the app because you can't actually use it.

So they took my money, but didn't' deliver the services and didn't not respond promptly (or at all yet) to my needs. Do not use this at present. It must have bugs while they attempt to upgrade. text: iPhone loading issues.
review: iPhone loading issues. Please fix this. It works well on my iPad & Mac, constantly refreshes during typing. Some files work better than others for adding updates. I'm tired of deleting the app or restarting my phone. It works, then it doesn't. Otherwise... it's a great & functional app. It's easy to navigate. It's free. No ads. I love it. But, I want to use it on all of my devices without glitches. I have stopped using Notion. The lag is beyond annoying. I can't open other documents on my MacBook. I used to use Notion for daily journaling. THANKS Apple for the journaling app, so I can leave this app behind. I used to love this app— but it's unreliable for daily tasks because of the "serious lag" & failure to open existing documents. This app is trying to do too much and it's rendered it USELESS! Look elsewhere, if you seek reliability.

text: Loved it, except recently... Using the mobile app since I'm usually on the move has been super helpful, on top of the fact that if I move my work online it keeps the formatting instead of making me go back to update them line by line.
review: Loved it, except recently... Using the mobile app since I'm usually on the move has been super helpful, on top of the fact that if I move my work online it keeps the formatting instead of making me go back to update them line by line. But recently, I found recently that the 'word count' function in the menu has disappeared which forces me to copy my work into Google Docs to see it. Nothing has helped (logging out, uninstalling/installing) and it's frustrating to have to waste time doing extra steps just to check simply because I don't have desktop access at that time. If this can get fixed then the app would easily go back up to 5 stars.

But recently, I found recently that the 'word count' function in the menu has disappeared which forces me to copy my work into Google Docs to see it. Nothing has helped (logging out, uninstalling/installing) and it's frustrating to have to waste time doing extra steps just to check simply because I don't have desktop access at that time. If this can get fixed then the app would easily go back up to 5 stars.

text: Great tool but no dynamic text sizes for accessibility?
review: Great tool but no dynamic text sizes for accessibility? I use this tool both personally and professionally. I also use it on both Android and iOS. It works great and is my go to for internal docs, notes, kanban boards. You name it - other than spreadsheets! Great tool! I am frustrated that the iOS version doesn't seem to support dynamic text sizes for page content. I need the default text size larger and, while the menus, titles, and buttons seem to get the larger dynamic text size, the page content remains the same size - somewhat invalidating the setting. It seems odd that this doesn't work properly on iOS given that this isn't even an issue on Android. This has been a problem for a while now and I would appreciate attention to this matter - a fix, and workaround (that actually works - accessibility settings per app and increasing it there also doesn't work).

text: I really want to like this app but it is so frustrating to have an Apple Pencil work flow on this app.
review: iPad work flow. I really want to like this app but it is so frustrating to have an Apple Pencil work flow on this app. Constant lagging and multiple touches to get even a toggle switch to turn on this interface. I have to constantly press with my pencil but it refuses to active any toggle action. I will highlight the action you want but will refuse to do. It might activate after the press of my pencil but just won't. I have to focus and dedicate more to maintaining my work flow and find ways around these problems, it is more frustrating and draws my focus away from my activity. Great app but an activity production app not working seamless with a basic pencil seems very redundant to a lot of people's work flow.

text: Rigid and unhelpful.
review: Rigid and unhelpful. If you have been on the internet in the last decade or so, this is a HUGE step back. It is rigid, with nonsensical rules that they refuse to change. There are a host of things you can't change that aren't just unhelpful, but maddening. Don't want comments on your page? Too bad. They don't care. Don't want a list of every connection your page has BEFORE you get to the actual page information? Nope. You can't. They know it's a problem and don't care. Want to simply move that issue to the bottom? Oh no. That would be crazy. This might be a decent product if they had half the options and functionality they claim to have. I'm a few hours in and feeling like I'm back the the internet circa 1998. Do better.

text: ADHD's, persist with Notion.
review: ADHD's, persist with Notion. Okay adhd people. You'll test it, not be able to work it out, get confused. Delete it. But just persist. Give it a few days. Watch some tutorials. Notion is fantastic once you figure out how to lay things out. There are some beautiful templates, but don't choose the prettiest one. Choose the functioning one. You will inevitably build the best system for you and you'll love it. Honestly, it does everything you need and then everything you didn't know it could do.

text: Another Poor iPad Version.
review: Another Poor iPad Version. It's wild to me that the iPad version of this app is as poorly optimised as it is. After getting a nice big iPad to handle simple notes, journals, and other organisation, I sort of assumed Notion would've figured out a satisfying experience to mirror all the other instances. Maybe I had my expectations out of whack. It'd be one thing if it was just the iPhone app (still disappointing) but certain functions just straight up don't work, and major ones no less, like simply moving sections around. I want to love Notion, but it's so disappointing to know that something so well suited to the purpose of Notion as the iPad (at least, in my opinion) clearly isn't a priority. But hey, at least their shareholders got another AI chat bot to peddle in meetings.

text: Rerouted and Pickpocketed.
review: Scam. Rerouted and Pickpocketed. I was really excited to use this app and I enjoyed using it to the point that I decided to buy the business Level subscription from them at $21 a month according to their website. When I tried to start the subscription, their Web app rerouted me to the iPhone App Store, and proceeded with the charging for the subscription. It wasn't until further inspection that I realized they rerouted me out of the business plan into a plus subscription and nearly double the website price for the same service. The service I needed had necessary integrations like GitHub, Google applications, etc. Instead, I just received a slightly expanded, Nerfed version of the free subscription and didn't get any of the features that I needed by actually paying for it, which were only three dollars more off their website. They don't even offer that subscription through the App Store so they're rerouting people and hoping they don't notice that they're being charged for the tier less a double the website price and three dollars less than the pro model which has like 50 more features than what there giving you. Keep an eye on Troupe Includes, as we prepare our open source version to rival this company. @ZigZagTroupe #DownWithShadyDevs

text: Lots of fixes needed instead of new features.
review: Lots of fixes needed instead of new features. I use this app a lot, and it is wonderful. For 2 years, I've waited and tried to use iOS shortcuts to upload photos to database directly or just create a new page with a template included. For some reason they've done the most random work on iOS shortcuts. New automations are created, but there's still no way to create a new page with the default template. It even says "template" as a parameter in shortcuts, but they haven't implemented it in the shortcut. There's also no way to create new page in shortcuts with certain blocks. Other smaller problems: The buttons inside Notion are convenient but missing tons of options to make it usable consistently. Links colors should be able to be changed from the default color, i.e I always want blue links instead slightly off gray. Also, the AI option should have an option to always yes disable it. It's useless to me, and I will never use. It just gets in the way, and I've definitely accidentally clicked it. I know it's to make money, but please let me have a hidden setting to never see it again.

text: Put me in the category of "Huh?!".
review: Mostly useless. Put me in the category of "Huh?!". It's a tool to organize notes and task lists - so what? There's no prioritization, little to no structure at the list/item level, reminder options are fixed and mostly useless. I can go on, but what's the point? If you want a clean, simple, note taking and task list organizing tool, it works perfectly fine. The issue is that scores of people over the years have actually put real effort into designing highly functional note taking and task list organizing tools. Use one of those. Oh, and don't get me started on the claim it can "track projects". That's a hard no - it does simple (child level) task lists - that is all.

text: The iPad app frustrates me to no end.
review: Love Notion. The iPad app frustrates me to no end. Both on the iPad mini and iPad Air, it is nothing but frustrating using Notion on an iPad to do anything other than look up what is already there. Feels like half the time I can't select anything. Using an Apple Pencil to interact is effectively non existent. Buggy is the norm. If I didn't enjoy Notion as a product so much I would be thinking of going elsewhere just because of how little I can get done using the app on my iPad. Feels like this has been going on forever and at this point can only wish that would do something about it.

text: I downloaded the app after getting a free trial through my LinkedIn premium.
review: Horrible experience. I downloaded the app after getting a free trial through my LinkedIn premium. Didn't use the app at all, honestly just couldn't figure it out. I cancelled the subscription before its renewal date and got emails stating that I still had a subscription or some kind of invoice. Apparently they wanted me to do some other things to actually cancel and apparently I didn't do that. Anyway, I've been communicating with the customer support team and they're just "oh I'm sorry but you still owe us the $10 even if you didn't use the platform and even if you did cancel." Sneaky and penny pinching. I get that in this day and age companies need to collect to stay around but seriously....read the room, word of mouth and bad experiences can have a lot more weight than a measly $10. Figure your problems out.

text: The Best App on Planet Earth.
review: The Best App on Planet Earth. I don't remember the last time I've given a review for an app. It's probably been last time I did one. I was probably a kid, probably around age 13, but I will give a very brief review of Notion. It can be overwhelming if you haven't figured out what systems you need or how to build systems. It can be underwhelming if you're not creative enough with it. At the end of the day though, I wholeheartedly believe that if you are someone who thinks in systems, who loves creative thinking and building in a way that pushes the boundary of what traditional pen and paper can offer, look no further than this app. This is the best app on the App Store in my opinion. This should be the number one app for the next ten years.

text: Good platform, terrible app.
review: Good platform, terrible app. I've been a Notion power user since about 2018. I rely on it for hours every day. The overall trajectory of the platform has been great since then, but the mobile app has always had issues. And it seems they are getting worse. Just about every app update these days introduces major workflow breaking bugs. For example, it worked perfectly yesterday until I updated to the latest version today, and now mobile dictation is completely broken. Currently, with many multi select properties, sometimes opening the selection window completely crashes the app and it must be manually restarted. Each update is like Russian Roulette: perhaps you'll gain some small feature, and hopefully you won't also get a new bug that completely interferes with usability. A bit hyperbolic? Sure. My business runs on this platform and bugs that break basic usability cost me. Will update this review if they manage to roll out 3 consecutive updates without breaking anything major.

review: Good platform, terrible app. I've been a Notion power user since about 2018. I rely on it for hours every day. The overall trajectory of the platform has been great since then, but the mobile app has always had issues. And it seems they are getting worse. Just about every app update these days introduces major workflow breaking bugs. For example, it worked perfectly yesterday until I updated to the latest version today, and now mobile dictation is completely broken. Currently, with many multi select properties, sometimes opening the selection window completely crashes the app and it must be manually restarted. Each update is like Russian Roulette: perhaps you'll gain some small feature, and hopefully you won't also get a new bug that completely interferes with usability. A bit hyperbolic? Sure. My business runs on this platform and bugs that break basic usability cost me. Will update this review if they manage to roll out 3 consecutive updates without breaking anything major.

text: Terrible Performance and Formatting on iPad Pro 13" M5.
review: Terrible Performance and Formatting on iPad Pro 13" M5. I just bought a brand new iPad Pro 13" M5 and was so excited to finally use Notion on iPad, but the performance is terrible and the responsive formatting is messed up (doesn't compare at all to the macOS Desktop app. The app is not smooth when scrolling, the text/content loads in chunks after 1-2 seconds when you scroll, and viewing tasks in a small display card doesn't keep the text readable like it does on the macOS Desktop app. About 2 years ago when I had an old iPad Pro in 2023, the performance was awesome and I used it all the time. Fast forward to today 1/25/26 on a brand new iPad just delivered yesterday 1/24/26 that app is unusable. Legit, disappointed. Please focus on fixing the performance and making this a usable app...

text: Great but.. The app excels in note-taking and task management, offering a user-friendly interface and reliable performance.
review: Great but.. The app excels in note-taking and task management, offering a user-friendly interface and reliable performance. Its AI features are impressive, providing helpful assistance and intelligent suggestions. However, the free usage is limited to 20 messages and it will not reset after it runs out, which can be restrictive for active users. To access more messages, users must upgrade to a paid plan. A more flexible approach would be to implement a reset mechanism, such as a daily or weekly reset of the message limit—similar to OpenAI's ChatGPT—allowing users to better manage their usage and continue benefiting from the AI without frequent interruptions.

text: minimal appearance options.
review: minimal appearance options. slight headache. i know that this critique seems minor, but it's very cumbersome to use the app when the look of it gets in the way. for example, the ai chat bubble that persistently exists on every single window—every page and every database view—is not only unnecessary, it's part of a larger problem: we can't get rid of it. including more visibility options seems in line with the main pro of notion: flexibility. for how much flexibility one gets in the functional parts of notion—e.g., in the views, the keystrokes, and the properties—it's strange that little effort is put into the flexibility of the interface. i'm sure y'all have had a lot of ideas for its interface bouncing around. why not include them all as options?

text: Latest update sacrifices collaboration for AI.
review: Latest update sacrifices collaboration for AI. It used to be that notifications were a convenient tab at the bottom, which makes sense because notion is a collaboration tool. Now, notifications have been moved to a very inconvenient top right corner while the AI search bar takes the bottom. I get the AI hype, but this is a horrible decision for the paying notion customer base, ie companies collaborating.

text: Powerful, flexible, and great for staying organized.
review: Powerful, flexible, and great for staying organized. Notion is one of the most versatile productivity apps I've used. It works well whether you're managing personal notes, tracking projects, or collaborating with a team. The flexibility is its biggest strength—you can start simple and gradually build more complex systems as your needs grow. I especially like how everything lives in one place: documents, databases, tasks, and ideas are easy to connect and reorganize. The interface is clean and modern, and once you get used to it, workflows feel very natural. Syncing across devices is reliable, which makes it easy to switch between phone, tablet, and desktop without losing context. There is a learning curve at the beginning, but plenty of templates and community resources help you get started quickly. Overall, Notion is a powerful tool for anyone who wants more control over how they organize information and work. It's not just a note-taking app—it's a flexible workspace that adapts to how you think and work.

text: AI toolbar is ruining my experience.
review: AI toolbar is ruining my experience. I've been a daily Notion user for at least 6 years now and the AI "helper" is ruining my overall UX - it opens when I don't want it to and there's no option to toggle it off. I'm a writer and will never need ai to "rewrite" anything I've put on my Notion pages, nor will I ever want to ask it questions. Please can you give me an option to disable this feature or at least make it less prominent, because I do not want it and am strongly considering just going back to good old pen and paper.

text: So honestly I went from never hearing about this app to it running my life in about a year.
review: Near Perfect. So honestly I went from never hearing about this app to it running my life in about a year. Damn near perfect product. So simple yet powerful and the ability to export to unlisted websites with the click of a button is amazing. I already run entire sections with QR code inventory tagging and cross database connections an automations. I'm in the military and as someone with ADHD and a ton of signed for property this app saved my mental health....my ONLY big issue is exporting. There has got to be a way to only export what I want and how I want it to an excel or pdf and so far I'm best served taking screenshots and stitching them together witch is just so sad. I have to have dozens of variables in the trackers but usually I only want to export a few columns and so far it always crams 90% of the data into what seems like a unorganized and totally senseless format.

text: It's amazing for organizing thoughts, job site, documentation, workers.
review: Work Operations. I'm new to Notion, it's only been a couple days. It's amazing for organizing thoughts, job site, documentation, workers. As a site supervisor, I have all the information I need at my fingertips. Sure, I have to add it all, but once it's in there, I can broadcast it company wide with a link and everyone has access. I've also opted for the paid version so AI works for me, and creating SOPs......well let's just say I didn't do them before. Now I can open 4- however many browser windows I want, give it a template with brief information for wash SOP. Hot enter then watch it create multiple SOPs white I wait and take the credit for all its work. (I do have to review and edit as required, but it's much more detailed then I would have been. Try it out if you haven't.

text: Home Button Replaced by AI Prompt.
review: Home Button Replaced by AI Prompt. A recent version of the app changed the shortcut buttons that were always available across the bottom of the app. One of these shortcuts that I really appreciated having was the Home button. Now the bottom area is occupied almost entirely by an AI conversation text field, even though I have not paid for AI and cannot use it. I have found that I can long press on the back arrow in the top left of a screen, which then offers me a menu to go back a page or go to home. I find this much less convenient than the previous dedicated Home button. I do recognize that the iPhone SE has a smaller screen than most phones, and it's possible that this is a dynamic layout issue that only happens on smaller screens. Even if that's the case, losing the button for an AI prompt area that I can't even use feels really bad. The rest of the app and Notion features are working wonderfully.

Now the bottom area is occupied almost entirely by an AI conversation text field, even though I have not paid for AI and cannot use it. I have found that I can long press on the back arrow in the top left of a screen, which then offers me a menu to go back a page or go to home. I find this much less convenient than the previous dedicated Home button. I do recognize that the iPhone SE has a smaller screen than most phones, and it's possible that this is a dynamic layout issue that only happens on smaller screens. Even if that's the case, losing the button for an AI prompt area that I can't even use feels really bad. The rest of the app and Notion features are working wonderfully.

text: Great notes tool for managing life in the information age.
review: Great notes tool for managing life in the information age. I wouldn't want to be without Notion anymore, for sure! But a couple of gripes: in the phone app the new AI function takes up way too much screen estate for something I never need, seeing the standard search is so great. And please add a setting where you can force a view to always load _all_ entries! (both mobile & desktop) It's so easy to miss stuff, especially in grouped views where each group may have one of those faint 'load more' lines. Or add a simple dropdown to the 'select all' checkbox, where you can pick 'all' or 'all visible'

text: Intentional Lack of Important, Basic Features.
review: Intentional Lack of Important, Basic Features. Probably the worst notes app I've ever had the pleasure of experiencing, all because they've done the work to be found near top search results through sponsored means, whether that be comments or ratings. It makes no sense why another individual would have to create an account just to see my document, especially if they're already going to be defaulted to read-only mode. This ultimately makes this app incredibly difficult to work with when working with others, as the question, "Why didn't I just make it in a text document with word or Google Docs?" There are plenty of open-source options. Don't even get me TOO started on the fact that the app allows offline downloads, but clearly is so insecure in its desire to consume user data and user interactions that you, as the user, are not allowed to even OPEN THE APP when you've disabled "Use Cellular Data" in your phone's settings. Actually pointless. I'll unfortunately be moving all of my notes over to a smarter, more competitive app; wherein I don't have to pay $20+ a month for automatic offline downloads, just to not be able to use the app if I turn cellular data off. Actually insane. Unlucky.

text: Notion is for everyone.
review: Notion is for everyone. Notion is the greatest platform ever built. I don't say this lightly or throw this around often. You can literally do anything you want in notion. If you're a lightweight user it's an aesthetically pleasing version of word with a better mobile experience and killer keyboard shortcuts. If you're a super user - there is no ceiling. You can run sprint boards for engineers, you can build board presentations, you can build a deal board for sales folks, you can leverage call recording and meetings notes. If you're a small biz owner and don't want to spend on software you can literally make pages shareable and have a website, run emails, have a calendar etc.

text: Has potential but too may bugs.
review: Has potential but too may bugs. This app is great in theory, I love all the different templates and being able to customize it to what I need. But it's not the most user friendly, and there seem to be a lot of bugs. I was playing around trying to find what works best for me, but then when I needed to delete pages that I no longer wanted, they don't delete. So I ended up with too many items on my homepage. They finally went away so now I just have the templates I want, but now the widget I added to my phone's Home Screen no longer works (it was working fine in the beginning). It's minor things, but they make it annoying to use the app. Hopefully things get sorted because from what I can see this app could be really useful

text: Please bring back the home/favorites button on the bottom left!!!
review: Please bring back the home/favorites button on the bottom left!!! Bring back the home/favorites button on the bottom left!!! It's so crucial for quickly navigating your favorites. Otherwise now I have to search for them which isn't nearly as fast, or press the back button which sometimes is 5 or 6 deep! Besides this, you have so many other issues. Load times are still slow and pages with databases that are heavy just constantly reload. Sometimes you barely can do anything on that page. Please also fix all the other issues I have sent to support. 2/27/2026. Still no fixes or better performance. Been an issue for years. It seems they just don't care about mobile at all, and it's getting worse. Now I wait to use Notion till I'm back at my desktop, which defeats the purpose of storing crucial notes and list for on the go!!! And didn't mention before, but iPad is basically unusable. You can't even change the time on your dates.

text: Promising but slow and finicky.
review: Promising but slow and finicky. It's really promising but the AI meeting notes are slower and more finicky the more I add to my workspace. Assume it's expensive for them to be running this but it has seemingly gotten less and less reliable on that front. The UI has also gotten harder to navigate as it's slower and slower. For something like sales notes I need to quickly and reliably find stuff which the ai assistant doesn't really do too well at yet... I wish I didn't buy the annual subscription and just paid monthly because I'm starting to just prefer Claude+OneNote anyway. Probably won't be renewing unless significant improvements are made in the next few months.

text: Love it overall, but a few issues on iPad mini. :).
review: Love it overall, but a few issues on iPad mini. :). I really love the integrated AI. It's incredibly helpful and makes my workflow so much smoother. Thank you for adding this feature. :(. However, the app keeps freezing after I write for just a few minutes on my iPad mini, especially when I use the floating small keyboard for dragging. It interrupts my work quite often. I really rely on Notion for my daily tasks, so I would truly appreciate it if this could be looked into and improved. It would also be much more convenient if all private notes could be listed without needing to tap "More". After tapping it, the list does not scroll properly anyway, which makes navigation frustrating. Thank you for your work on the app. I'm looking forward to future improvements.

text: Dont bother with IPad App.
review: Dont bother with IPad App. Notion is great to use most of the time but the IPad app is FULL of bugs and glitches that seem to never be getting fixed. I'm a Uni student and notion is what i use for all of my notes so when it stops working mid way through my day it is extremely frustrating. I love using this to format my notes, especially as someone with ADHD so I really wish they would work on quality of life updates for the app rather than introducing shiny new features that cause more issues than they are worth. FIX THE APP!!!

text: Notion has become one of my favorite tools for taking notes and organizing ideas.
review: Best notetaker. Notion has become one of my favorite tools for taking notes and organizing ideas. I like how flexible it is. You can turn a simple page into a full workspace with lists, databases, and structured notes without it feeling complicated. Everything stays in one place, which makes it easy to keep track of projects, thoughts, and daily planning. What I appreciate the most is how customizable it is. I can structure my notes exactly how I want instead of forcing them into a rigid template. It works just as well for quick brainstorming as it does for detailed project planning. If you are someone who likes clarity and organization when working or studying, Notion is an incredibly powerful tool. Once you get used to it, it becomes hard to imagine managing information any other way.

text: Gen AI is BAD, FORCED PAYMENT.
review: Gen AI is BAD, FORCED PAYMENT. So basically the constant advances and pushing of AI from the app itself has been increasing constantly to the point where, you'll accidentally click on the AI stuff and it tries to force you to use it. This is only ONE of the negatives, but the worst part is once you run out of free storage you are FORCED to purchase more storage or you have to just make a new account altogether. This is because even if you delete things to make more space it doesn't actually give you your storage back meaning, you deleted it for nothing because you still don't have any space. Once you run out of space it prevents you from actually being able to even add bullet points or any feature outside of typing and even that is limited. You can't add anything at all once you run out of storage, deleting things doesn't give you more storage, and you literally have 0 other options. This is horrible, like genuinely everyone should find better alternatives because this is just ridiculous, personally I WILL be finding alternatives and stop using notion.

This is because even if you delete things to make more space it doesn't actually give you your storage back meaning, you deleted it for nothing because you still don't have any space. Once you run out of space it prevents you from actually being able to even add bullet points or any feature outside of typing and even that is limited. You can't add anything at all once you run out of storage, deleting things doesn't give you more storage, and you literally have 0 other options. This is horrible, like genuinely everyone should find better alternatives because this is just ridiculous, personally I WILL be finding alternatives and stop using notion.

text: Don't Be Like Me.
review: Don't Be Like Me. I've been a moderate-heavy user for over a year and I would never pay for this software. No matter where you use it, tables are an atrocious disappointment and the general UI is cumbersome at best. On mobile, where I need it the most, it seemingly can barely handle 50 short lines of plain text without crashing. Maybe it's great the way other people use it, or maybe the people who sing its praises just don't know what non-Apple software is like and overvalue surface aesthetics. Either way, unless you only take notes on Mac and you don't have much to actually write down, give this one a pass. I'm only still here trying to finesse it to do the bare minimum of what I need because of switching costs.

Either way, unless you only take notes on Mac and you don't have much to actually write down, give this one a pass. I'm only still here trying to finesse it to do the bare minimum of what I need because of switching costs.

text: Love Notion, the iPhone app needs polishing.
review: Love Notion, the iPhone app needs polishing. Notion is a godsend to me. Don't know where I'd be without it. However, the Ui bugs when trying to use databases make it frustrating to use. I imagine it's hard because of the complexity of that UI, but it would be better to have less features on the iOS version and have them all work perfectly than have some bugs break what you're doing. That being said, love the phone app for jotting notes and simpler tasks.

text: AI might be good for some, but for me it was the end.
review: AI might be good for some, but for me it was the end. Years ago, I was recommended this note tool via word of mouth. I initially loved it! Being able to switch between devices as I needed was a big plus for my writing, and I loved the stacking folders and clean ui. I had no need for ai when it launched. It was unobtrusive, however, so I carried on. Then, a badly implemented update caused a piece of writing I had worked on for hours to, with an easy keyboard stumble, be completely rewritten. Completely. Hours of work chewed up and spit out into slush. :/ I promptly closed the app and stopped writing in it. Years later, I have found a software I like better, with no intrusive ai and no cloud services, so my notes are no longer at risk in a server I don't have access to. I have zero faith that notion has kept anything I ever wrote secure. They continue to say one thing and do another. I am done. In logging in to transfer my notes, I notice that the program is buggy and slow in ways it never was years ago. Buffers like crazy. It's actually kind of heartbreaking to see how far this app has fallen. There are better options out there, with more security and better customization. Even if you want ai in a notes app, there are more clean and helpful options that do not compromise your experience. Why pick notion? I never will again.

review:
强制推送AI功能,破坏用户体验. 之前的 Notion 页面简洁美观,功能实用,能让用户专注于笔记本身。然而,更新后的版本在每个页面底部强制添加了三个丑陋且干扰视线的按钮:. 1. 搜索按钮(重复功能,原本已有快捷键和顶部搜索框);. 2. 占据最大空间的AI按钮(明显为推销其不实用的AI功能,并不好用);. 3. 新建页面按钮(同样重复)。 问题核心:. •强制推销:AI 功能非但不好用,还占用界面空间,严重影响笔记的视觉整洁性。 •无法关闭:未提供用户自定义隐藏这些按钮的选项,用户选择权。 感觉平台是在逼着用户离开。已经开始到了虐待用户的程度了吗?这么快已经开始进入这个阶段了吗?
(English translation: Compulsory pushing AI functions, damaging the user experience. The previous Notion pages were simple, beautiful, and functional, allowing users to focus on the notes themselves. However, the updated version compulsorily added three ugly and disturbing buttons at the bottom of each page: 1 of The search button (repeated function, which originally had shortcuts and the top search box); 2nd The AI button that occupies the most space (obviously not good for promoting its impractical AI functionality); Three New page button (the same repeats). The core question: Compulsory marketing: AI functions are not only useless, but also occupy interface space, seriously affecting the visual cleanliness of the notes. • Unable to turn off: Users do not have the option to customize hiding these buttons. It feels like the platform is forcing users to leave. Has the level of abuse begun? has it begun to enter this phase so soon?)

text: I really enjoy using Notion, but lately it's been crashing and not uploading my pages on my iPad.
review: Keeps crashing. I really enjoy using Notion, but lately it's been crashing and not uploading my pages on my iPad. Seems like it's not really compatible for the iPad anymore as it's a recurring error. I have to keep deleting the app or logging out and back in for it to work. Or I will use it on my PC when I get home, but I need it for work so, it's not helpful if I can't use it on my iPad.

text: The new update sucks.
review: The new update sucks. I've been using notion for a long time and it had no problems. Now when I try to press "improve writing" a chat opens up and ruins the fast and easy process it used to have. It has tightened its polices and will barely help me brainstorm, let alone write anything that is even close to being "explicit" the ai is completely useless now. The app completely sucks, it's not even fun to use anymore. I used to use it to help me write the best of my abilities and now because of the new updates that's not only hard but impossible since apparently everything I write is "illegal and harmful" (in its own words).

text: Great app, unfortunate decisions.
review: Great app, unfortunate decisions. I thought the point of an app like this was to create a platform for artists. Doesn't matter what kind of art it is, this is a great place to really customize every last detail of. your organization. Having generative AI features to come up with concepts FOR you defeats that purpose. Encourage people to get creative, experience real human trial and error. Because that's what makes life fulfilling. I'm disappointed that companies would rather do what they think will make them the most money VS what's actually good for humanity. As long as your pockets are full though, right? I would absolutely adore this app if it weren't for the lazy and harmful features they call innovative. Remember, knowledge is power. ❤️

text: Best organized writing and notes app imo, but program speed could be more seamless on phone.
review: Best organized writing and notes app imo, but program speed could be more seamless on phone. I enjoyed this app very much, started using it when I was younger and didn't learn to use the maximum of its organizational benefits till recently. I think it is much much better now although a lot of the core organizational features were there to begin with... well all in all I know I will keep using this for creative writing and making sure I keep up with course work. It is a very flexible app if you take the time to organize databases and properties/tags effectively. I would recommend to anyone who has trouble creatively expressing their thoughts as well as people who are in demanding student programs and of course I think it is already used in corporate society but I think the benefits for that are less. Well I guess we'll see when I graduate and decide to look for work! Ok thank you for reading and taking the time if these resonate with you.

text: Great App, but Needs Offline Access.
review: Great App, but Needs Offline Access. I think the app is excellent overall, and I really appreciate the clean layout and smooth user experience. My main concern, however, is that I'm unable to access my notes without a Wi-Fi or cellular connection. This feels limiting, as I should be able to view notes I've already saved regardless of internet access. This becomes especially important when traveling or in situations where reliable connectivity isn't available. In those moments, having my notes inaccessible can be frustrating and inconvenient especially for someone like myself who needs them for frequent reference. I'd greatly appreciate it if offline access could be added or improved in a future update.

text: I use a lot of pictures on Notion but ever since the last couple updates Notion has been unusable.

Pages don't load, they automatically refresh out of nowhere multiple times when you scroll, and pictures don't load. The only way to get all pictures to load is to constantly refresh the page almost 20 times and then refresh it more to be able to upload more photos. I loved using Notion back in 2024 but now it's always making me annoyed or frustrated. It's good for notes but absolutely terrible for more than 4 pictures on one page. Please fix it.

I loved using Notion back in 2024 but now it's always making me annoyed or frustrated. It's good for notes but absolutely terrible for more than 4 pictures on one page. Please fix it.

text: Productivity Unlocked for Creatives!
review: Productivity Unlocked for Creatives! As a medical student who identifies heavily with visual learning, creativity and planning, this app has become my new favorite. It is easier for me to work on tasks when I can make them fun. I can take breaks and switch between productive pages like my to-do-list to more creative ones like my poetry page. I can add pictures to my document at the top like a little theme in the header. I can use the AI tool to add features I want like "strikethrough" or "make this bullet-point a checkbox" and it will do it for me. If idk how to do something I want for my document, I can ask the AI tool and it'll figure it out for me. This is my new favorite app!

text: Really love this app but there's a few things.... Ultimately, I really love notion and its rich feature set.
review: Really love this app but there's a few things.... Ultimately, I really love notion and its rich feature set. I love the experience on my laptop but the experience on iPad for me has been hit and miss. I strongly feel like the Apple Pencil integration is not where I need it to be for note taking, and there's just some awkward styling issues on my iPad 11 pro M5 in vertical like no left padding on the content panel and slightly clipped panel header. I'm still going to use it because I really like it, but the Apple Pencil issue actually does prevent me from using it in all the ways I really want to and means I go elsewhere for those needs.

text: Best for sharing notes.
review: Best for sharing notes. The best thing I like about Notion is that I can give people in some access to notes that I have created. The notes become a URL and it makes it so convenient. My problem with Notion is the set up on the emergency. Seems a little busy. I want really some guidance to how to organize it. It seems so much and I just want plain organization. Like Microsoft OneNote is simple. It's a bookshelf and it's easy for me to see how I'm organizing things. Notion hasn't set up more visually and I still need some help because there are too many ways that you can see things. And there are terms that I don't understand.

Like Microsoft OneNote is simple. It's a bookshelf and it's easy for me to see how I'm organizing things. Notion hasn't set up more visually and I still need some help because there are too many ways that you can see things. And there are terms that I don't understand.

text: I LOVE NOTION BUT NOT ON IPAD/TABLET/PHONE 2.5/5 stars.
review: I LOVE NOTION BUT NOT ON IPAD/TABLET/PHONE 2.5/5 stars. I never imagined I would rate notion this low but I used to use notion on my computer and it was absolutely wonderful it helped me organise and just keep myself together and that would be a 5/5 i had notion on my phone at one point but deleted it soonly after as the graphics were too small and hard to edit. And I was like I just set up this iPad properly let me download notion,such a good idea right? WRONGGGGGG. I have been using this app for less than 10 minutes and I can't even tell you how many times it has crashed,blacked out,kicked me off the app and all i was trying to do was add a cover. And it's not as if I am pressing any wrong buttons or something because i have used notion since 2022 so I know how to use it. FOR PEOPLE WHO WANTS NOTION ON THEIR TABLET/IPAD:I have heard that using the web version on notion by using a search engine such as google will work better I guess I will try that even though I normally prefer the app version if not on desktop/laptop. NOTION PLEASE FIX THE BUGS ON PHONE AND IPAD/TABLETS

text: Overall ..it's okay.
review: Overall ..it's okay. At first, the app was great—I found it very practical and easy to use. However, I'm not sure if it's because I've created several entries, but now I'm experiencing multiple issues. I have to delete and reinstall the app because I can no longer add photos to my tasks. I also can't select dates from the calendar anymore and have to enter them manually. Additionally, I'm unable to write comments under my tasks—what I type simply doesn't save or send. In short, it was perfect at the beginning, but now it has become almost unusable.

text: Each update fixes some breaks others.
review: Each update fixes some breaks others. The latest update left my iPhone 12 Pro Max unable to let me to change the cover image. The change cover page crashes just as the change cover page appears. Previous review:. Just noticed that I, a paying Notion Plus subscriber can no longer use Notion AI. Welp, I'm definitely not going to use Notion AI now that I have to upgrade and pay more than 4 times what I normally pay yearly. And you can't turn it off or even hide it! Everyone knows AI is very flawed and yet these tech companies want to charge so much for it! And anyone who uses Notion knows how flawed it is, which makes it all the more frustrating. It's got a truly great structure to it making it incredibly versatile, but it's like a plane with small wings and no engines. But hey, you can pay for a somewhat dim flight attendant. OK, this is my previous review:. Just updated the app, sad to see image files load but then turn white and require me to scroll back up and then over the images to get them to show. Every time I load the page with images in it I have to scroll up and down again. The white screen may not seem like much but it's annoying in dim light or when updating a journal in bed at night with the lights out. Been using Notion for 8 months now and am kind of surprised this hasn't been fixed yet. My original review: it really needs a few things—most importantly, encryption for us poor folks. It looks like you have to be an enterprise customer to get anything resembling actual privacy and it's unclear what you get is encryption. We live in a time where our data is making people tons of money. I'd rather they not make money off of my notes and my used habits. Also, this needs the same notes graph/map/diagram thingy that a few Notion competitors have that allows you to visualize how all of your notes are related to each other. It is such a cool and helpful way to see the big picture on your projects! The third thing I think it needs is just a slightly better UI. It does a lot but it can be pretty challenging to navigate/find everything. I haven't checked yet but I suspect that YouTube is the user's friend along these lines. Otherwise, Notion is a fricken Swiss Army Knife app—you can literally keep a journal, a journal within a journal, a wiki, multiple wikis, I can't even list all the templates this thing has. It's really nuts how much you can do with Notion! I just wish it had encryption and the other couple things it's competition has.

text: Useless if you plan on using voice to text.
review: Useless if you plan on using voice to text. The voice to text functionality of the app continually degrades overtime. It simply cannot function for taking notes in this method as it will do a terrible job at detecting the proper words, that is if you get to keep the words after you are done with your prompt. You will literally see the words be removed when you are finished right in front of your eyes. This is nothing new, and has been common for a little over two years, and I have simply stopped using Notion on my devices because it may be a powerful tool, but for brainstorming it is completely useless when trying to use voice to text.

text: Wish it didn't have AI.
review: Wish it didn't have AI. Had to delete because of the AI. Obviously AI is not only terrible for the environment (uses so much water without recycling it) and contributes to cognitive decline (our brains need to stretch and work doing even "simple" things to build and maintain key neural pathways), it's also a massive security risk AND the generative aspect of it straight up just doesn't work, like you end up typing like four or five prompts in and faffing about refining the result that it would have taken less time just to write whatever you were trying to make the AI write. As much as I hate AI, I really really loved Notion and I would have kept it if they'd have some option for toggling off the AI features. They're just really obtrusive and obnoxious for how useless/harmful they are, like I don't want an AI assistant helping me write and stealing my content. But rather than remove or add an off-switch, the developers just kept cramming more AI slop in there, so I've had to delete it. It's such a crying shame. I recalled loved Notion. I'd come back in a heartbeat if they ditched the AI slop.

text: Notion ai is becoming unusable to story writers and authors, seriously revert it back.
review: Notion ai is becoming unusable to story writers and authors, seriously revert it back. I genuinely don't understand why Notion AI removed some of its most useful features like improve writing, continue writing, saved prompts, etc. The old system with the blue highlighted text and a confirm button made it so easy to see exactly what the AI changed before accepting it. And the continue writing button was a lifesaver you didn't even need to think of a prompt it would just keep your work going instantly. As a student that saved me so much time and now I feel like I'm doing extra steps for something I'm literally paying to make faster. They even removed all the saved prompts and turned them into these "skills" which just makes everything more complicated for no reason. I get that they're trying to push more advanced AI features and automation but it feels like they sacrificed simplicity and usability in the process. Are they planning to fix this or bring back those features in some way? And is there any way at all to revert to the older version because this update honestly feels like a downgrade 😭

And the continue writing button was a lifesaver you didn't even need to think of a prompt it would just keep your work going instantly. As a student that saved me so much time and now I feel like I'm doing extra steps for something I'm literally paying to make faster. They even removed all the saved prompts and turned them into these "skills" which just makes everything more complicated for no reason. I get that they're trying to push more advanced AI features and automation but it feels like they sacrificed simplicity and usability in the process. Are they planning to fix this or bring back those features in some way? And is there any way at all to revert to the older version because this update honestly feels like a downgrade 😭
