text: Used to be great.
review: Used to be great. Notion used to be great because they innovated, listened to customers and actually developed useful tools. Now, each month brings new changes that are nothing more than money grubbing attempts while longstanding issues with usability of the mobile app, stability of the content, etc remain unfixed. While customer support is fast, it's likely a bot coz they don't seem to understand the issue and mostly just kicks it to "engineering" without any workarounds or understanding. Worst thing is: you prepay for the subscription and even if you don't like it, it doesn't work, you can't get a refund not even a partial.

text: Everything is super, but mobile version... I really love Notion and have been using it for several years.
review: Everything is super, but mobile version... I really love Notion and have been using it for several years. But please, developers, do something about the mobile version. Every time I spend a while inside a note working with text, after about 10–15 minutes, Notion stops responding to taps, doesn't allow editing, and I have to close the app and reopen it. This reduces productivity and is very inconvenient. I don't experience this issue in other apps where I work with text, so the problem isn't my iPhone. Thank you!

text: Use to be a good tool.
review: Use to be a good tool. Few years back, I was the one who transitioned my company to Notion, and now I wish it didn't happen. I loved how simple and reliable it was. Now it's so overcomplicated I spend more time to organize things than working. AI that so useless not sure when you need it. Docs jump all the time, hard to redact text, columns, and you can invcert picture to the chart unless it's data base, please give me a break.

text: Easy Mode Button Please.
review: Easy Mode Button Please. First time I downloaded your app I deleted it after half a day. Then I downloaded it again when we integrated it with our overall flow. It is overwhelming. I am not a power user (like,I guess your target audience) but could you just make an easy mode that strips down all the enormous amount of options and features and tweaks. Just a way to add a simple todo list like tasks or Apple reminders; add notes (pages) in a simple way. Later maybe newb users like me would switch off easy mode and use the whole thing. But dang it would be nice for when you have are just switching over to get started. I downloaded a 3rd party app just to have a normal todo list. And yes. I know you have a long list of how to learn to use your system check boxes. But sheesh, hard to carve out time in the middle of a normal work week. Just a suggestion from us more simple folk. Ha! Oh and a quick note/todo add widget would be nice. Thank you for your time.

text: Finally found a system that works with my brain.
review: Finally found a system that works with my brain. I've tried a lot of productivity and organization apps over the years, but Notion is the first one that actually feels flexible enough to grow with how I think instead of forcing me into someone else's system. I originally started using it for notes and organization, but it quickly became a place where I could connect ideas, workflows, AI concepts, healthcare operations, and long-term planning in a way that feels natural and visual. What I appreciate most is that it works for both structured thinking and creative thinking at the same time. I can build detailed workflow maps one minute and brainstorm future ideas the next without switching platforms. As someone working in healthcare operations and AI workflow design, I also love how adaptable it is for building living systems instead of static documents. It genuinely helped me feel more organized, focused, and excited about my ideas again.

text: The iPad App is basically view-only.
review: The iPad App is basically view-only. I will start by saying I love Notion. I use it to organize both my work and personal lives. For work, I primarily access Notion using my desktop computer. However, for my personal life, my main device is an iPad Pro with Magic Keyboard. The Notion app on iPad lacks so many features (calendar, etc) or glitches (moves the screen down when trying to type, so you cannot see the text as you type it) as to make it almost impossible to edit or create pages on an iPad. It is essentially a view-only system for existing content. Extremely disappointing given how much success I have had using Notion in my professional life - I was hoping to replicate that in my personal life, but that would involve the iPad app working...

I have TONS of material lovingly crafted and ordered thanks to this app. Yet the app has become more and more buggy, slow, and hard to engage with. I'm angry because of what it should be and isn't!!! All because of issues that other apps on my phone are not sharing, ie, they must be native. Please please fix things guys! You're an amazing platform that is being dragged through the cesspool of performance issues!

text: Me ha organizado la vida.
review:
Me ha organizado la vida. Siempre me ha gustado mucho escribir mis tareas y mis pensamientos personales, pero en cuadernos me desorganizaba mucho y no los tenía siempre a la mano. Cuando empecé a usar Notion por recomendación de una amiga, fue una transición rara entre el papel y la pantalla, pero ya una vez acostumbrada he podido sacarle mucho provecho. Lo uso a diario porque es fácil e intuitivo. Se puede encontrar una metodología de uso muy personal. Además tiene una linda estética. Tiene sus limitaciones naturalmente, sobretodo en cuanto a las tablas, pero es una gran app de notas.
(English translation: He organized my life. I’ve always liked to write my tasks and my personal thoughts, but in notebooks I disorganized a lot and didn’t always have them at hand. When I started using Notion on the recommendation of a friend, it was a rare transition between the paper and the screen, but once used to it I was able to take a lot of benefit from it. I use it every day because it’s easy and intuitive. A very personal methodology can be found. It also has a beautiful aesthetic. It has its limitations naturally, especially as far as tables are concerned, but it’s a great note app.)

text: Recent update issue.
review: Recent update issue. It has been the same way for my mobile devices and my friends mobile devices. The push for AI is also annoying, it's unnecessary and needs to be placed elsewhere or have a way to be turned off. I didn't have issues when I downloaded it at first but lately more and more updates seem to be breaking the code in a way that makes the app nearly unusable and very unstable. Please fix your app, it's great for creative projects but is very annoying when it continues to crash over and over and options to edit things don't work, it become more of a hassle and does not make people want to use it.

I have so much data here I almost have to use it - but in the back of my mind I kind of want out. I'm hopeful that the team will improve performance to give a bit more confidence in the stability of the system but the app has lost its glow.

text: A nearly perfect app.
review: A nearly perfect app. I have loved using Notion for so many reasons. There is a learning curve with this app, but once you figure it out it is an amazing tool. My only problem is the AI chat button at the bottom of the screen. I mostly use a very small device when I am on Notion and the AI text box takes up a lot of the screen and gets in my way. I never need it right there when I am writing on my pages and I really wish that there was a setting that allows me to hide or remove it. Besides this problem there is really nothing bad I can say about the app and I would highly recommend it. I hope that this is changed in the future.

text: The iPhone and web versions of Notion are themselves quite glitchy and sometimes baffling from a UX perspective.
review: iPad Support. The iPhone and web versions of Notion are themselves quite glitchy and sometimes baffling from a UX perspective. But the iPad experience is inexcusable and effectively unusable. I don't know how the app says "Supported on this iPad" and even has an Editor's Choice award when even if you go to Notion support to ask about all of the bugs in the iPad experience, the bot will just tell you that iPad isn't supported at all. That isn't a defensible position at all in 2026, and it's incredibly misleading given the stated support in the App Store.

text: The BackBone Source of truth.
review: The BackBone Source of truth. Review: The Ultimate "Brain" for AI Development. Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐. Notion has completely transformed how I manage and execute technical projects. Instead of scattered notes, it serves as the ultimate external "brain" and central knowledge repository for my automated workflows, specifically when feeding context into Claude Code and my agentic systems. What makes Notion indispensable for an AI-driven development environment:. Structured Context: The ability to seamlessly organize markdown files (.md), system configurations, and project documentation makes it incredibly easy to pull structured data into an AI context. Clean Markdown Support: Because Notion handles markdown natively, exporting clean, structured data for programmatic use or CLI tools is seamless. Frictionless Organization: It provides a highly scannable, deeply organized hierarchy that keeps massive amounts of technical data manageable without feeling overwhelming. Whether you are mapping out logic or building a dynamic knowledge base for AI agents to query, Notion bridges the gap between human planning and machine execution perfectly. Highly recommended for anyone running modern, agentic workflows.

text: Used to love it, grown to hate it.

I am looking for a similar tool without AI, but with the same aesthetic appeal and better functionality. Truly I am disappointed by Notion.

text: So far so good.
review: So far so good. ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆. Just getting started with Notion, but I'm really liking it so far. There was definitely a bit of a learning curve in the beginning, and it can feel a little overwhelming when you're first figuring out how everything works. That said, once I started using ChatGPT to help me create prompts and build out systems, things started clicking much faster. I'm currently using it to organize a large historical archive project, and I'm impressed by how customizable and powerful it seems. I'm still learning my way around the platform, but I can already see the potential. Looking forward to exploring more features and seeing what else it can do.

text: So close to perfect.
review: So close to perfect. I am a paying user if that says anything. The app is so close to being my sole productivity tool. The thing that keeps from being that for me, is that it just keeps fumbling the ball at the simple blocking and tackling. The iPad and IOS apps are just atrocious and do not play well with stage manager, to the point that it just makes the app unusable at times. Things like navigation from the marketplace just isn't intuitive. Want to undo a change you made? Can't do it. How do I go from the marketplace back to my homepage you may ask? The only way is to close the app and open it back up. That is just not how it should work! I wish the apps were as useful/bug free as the web version, which is simply the best. There just needs to be some work put into cleaning it up and making it more easy/accessible to use.

text: I love notion, use it consistently for school & life.
review: Love Notion. I love notion, use it consistently for school & life. But the app needs some improvement. I primarily use my iPad & the functionality of the app on this device is decent... & thats kinda generous. There's so many things I literally cannot do on my iPad & MUST switch to my computer to do whatever im trying to do. It's not just 1 thing, it's multiple. Currently, I've run into the issue where I cant add options for my select property. It literally will not let me type an option. I love notion, i use it consistently, I just wish there was more time put into the app development & functionality instead of the AI. I really dont care for the AI feature ngl.

text: Revolutionized my Life.
review: Revolutionized my Life. Notion is my second brain. I can't say enough good things about it, I tell everyone I know about it, and I have no idea what I did before this app, or how I'll function without it after. The free form creativity of it is unmatched. I've tried Trello, asana, and a few others for project management and tracking my life, but Notion is the hub for my small business CRM, my personal calendar and goal tracking, it holds the list for the books I want to read, all of my budgets, all of my tasks. I've made it a period tracker, a journal, a workout hub; IT CAN DO AND BE EVERYTHING AND ANYTHING. I am the exact target audience for Notion. Thank you to everyone who made this beautiful, simple, intelligent app possible.

text: Can you please fix your Ipad app bugs?
review: Can you please fix your Ipad app bugs? Update 21/06/26. Had to lower the rating because for the last month or so Notion stopped working properly with my iPad when I use a Bluetooth keyboard - the pages no longer allow me to type, my spacebar np longer works and I can't use any of the arrow keys. This renders the app almost entirely useless since If I can't type in the pages, I can't use it for anything else. My keyboard has no issues with any other apps and I have had it for years now, so I know it is not the problem. It seems development and optimisation is way off when it comes to IOS / iPad work, which is a shame.

text: I love notion but when I'm trying to contact costumer service.
review: I love notion but when I'm trying to contact costumer service. I've been using Notion for a while, and I really love the app. It's been an amazing tool for staying organized. However, I'm disappointed with my recent billing experience. My subscription increased from $12 to $26, and I wanted to speak with a customer support representative to understand why. Unfortunately, when I try to submit a support request, the form won't let me enter my email address, so I can't even contact support. I hope this issue is fixed soon because I'd like to continue using and recommending Notion.

text: The best productivity App I've Ever used.
review: The best productivity App I've Ever used. I've been using Notion for over 3 years now, and I honestly can't imagine organizing my life without it. text: Used to Love this App/Program.
review: Used to Love this App/Program. I first discovered notion through work and really loved it. So, I began using it for personal items I wanted to document. Ever since the whole platform started pushing AI and became an AI workspace it has done nothing but go downhill. Functions within the app and on desktop used to work flawlessly. Now I can't even do simple tasks without it acting buggy. I try to type in a table and it doesn't work. Today it won't even refresh at all. The only difference I've noticed since the quality began going down hill is their push with AI. Notion wasn't all about AI previously and now that it is, it does not work as intended. I wish I didn't have to find a new platform but I might because this isn't working for me. At this point I'll just go back to using Google Docs. I don't want to support them and Gemini either but at least their products work as intended even with the integration of AI.

text: Not good, not worth it.
review: Not good, not worth it. I have paid for the Notion Plus subscription for some time. I was worried when they introduced AI features but I stuck with it because I liked the product and they had been good so far. I regret that now. The app is still horrible and slow on mobile, nearly as bad on desktop, buggy, doesn't give power users the features they need. STILL I paid for my subscription even though the app never improved. But today is the straw that broke the camel's back: I pay for Plus but I can't retrieve document versions older than 90 days without paying even MORE for an Enterprise plan? I'm going to be getting my things off this platform as soon as possible. I can't support this anymore. If the app gets overhauled, I'll check in again. But I can't put up with no improvements AND being nickel-and-dimed for basic features that should be included in my subscription. You had a great idea and you've run it into the ground.

The app is still horrible and slow on mobile, nearly as bad on desktop, buggy, doesn't give power users the features they need. STILL I paid for my subscription even though the app never improved. But today is the straw that broke the camel's back: I pay for Plus but I can't retrieve document versions older than 90 days without paying even MORE for an Enterprise plan? I'm going to be getting my things off this platform as soon as possible. I can't support this anymore. If the app gets overhauled, I'll check in again. But I can't put up with no improvements AND being nickel-and-dimed for basic features that should be included in my subscription. You had a great idea and you've run it into the ground.

text: Still appalling on iOS - any plans for change??
review: Still appalling on iOS - any plans for change?? I tried this app a couple of years ago as I loved it on my laptop, and I decided to try it again because I assumed that by now they should have fixed the iPad/iPhone functionality up a bit. I was wrong. I actually don't understand how you can have such an appalling usability as an app but be so good on the web, and continue to stay unusable as an app for years at a time despite all the reviews telling you how bad your app is. I can't access templates (FREE templates) on my iPad, it takes me 30 seconds to open old notes, the dashboard and sidebar glitch around once a minute, I struggle to load things up, it drains my battery stupidly quickly and don't even get me STARTED on trying to type things/use the keyboard. Seriously, why is it so hard to do literally anything on the app? The degree to which things STILL don't work after 2 years is surreal to me.

text: This app reminds me of those knockoff AI-built apps that try to reinvent everything but end up being overly complicated and difficult to use.
review: Child's play. This app reminds me of those knockoff AI-built apps that try to reinvent everything but end up being overly complicated and difficult to use. What should be a simple daily planning and logging system quickly turned into what felt like an IT database management project. I used it for one day, and before I could even get a simple planner set up in a way that made sense, I had already run out of credits/tokens. It seems like the app is trying to reinvent the wheel with every little feature, adding unnecessary complexity instead of making things easier. Honestly, it's just too much for me. I'll stick to journaling on paper—it's simpler, faster, and actually works.

text: The latest update renders the app useless.
review: The latest update renders the app useless. I use the app version of Notion primarily for sending and using links within tables and databases while I'm away from my computer - recipes, articles, ideas, etc. The latest update truncates the content of the tables and databases to 5 characters, so I can only figure out what I'm accessing only when I'm on my desktop or mobile versions of Notion. Hate it. Frustrating AF. Please fix it (by untruncating) so I can continue using the app within my daily workflows. Also hate the update that randomly starts consuming AI agent coins, but that's mostly a business model thing rather than a serious usability issue.

review:
新出现的问题. 最近的更新中,在ios 18上面,添加照片的底部弹窗变成了透明背景,失去可读性;workspace 顶部的最近项目变更了标题列表,没有原来的横向滑动方块显示优雅了;键盘上方的快速组件按钮似乎是每次打开都重新加载,有时看不到图标。
(English translation: newly emerging problems. In the recent update, on the iOS 18, the bottom pop-up of the photo added turned into a transparent background, losing readability; the recent item on the top of the workspace changed the title list, with no original horizontal sliding square display more elegant; the quick component button on the keyboard seemed to be re-loaded every time it was opened, and sometimes no icons were visible.)

text: Notion is so rich with potential the breadth of what it can do is limitless.
review: Limitless Potential. Notion is so rich with potential the breadth of what it can do is limitless. That strength however can be its "weakness" as one can easily get overwhelmed of its learning curve. This is the type of app that one just needs to use regularly and consistently to fully appreciate its power. The myriad of tips and recommendations available, though really impressive, can overwhelm too. Just start using it to fit your need and gradually add features as you get accustomed — all fee-free and ad-free!

text: Used to be incredible, but once again has been run down by pointless AI 'tools' that nobody asked fo.
review: Used to be incredible, but once again has been run down by pointless AI 'tools' that nobody asked fo. I've been using notion for almost 5 years now, I used to use it almost daily until recently I found a much better app for my notes. I mourn the days of notion before AI started being shoved down our throats, I seriously can't explain how great notion used to be, but it's all gone now. With the useless AI features and confusing UI it's safe to say that I will not be using notion anymore and I advise everyone else to look for better alternatives :)

text: Notion fell off 💔.
review: Notion fell off 💔. Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used! You can't do anything without the screen freezing and it feels like it's just turned into a generic ai chatbot app with a little bit of organisation on the side (that doesn't even work most of the time??) it's so disappointing to see and I hope the creators import an ai-free version for notetakers who actually think for themselves, perhaps the lack of ai will make some of the other features less laggy.

Then I started tinkering with the A.I. and every day I learned something about Notion functionality that delights me. I'm seeing serious efficiency gains and a goal that I've had to establish a second brain database has been achieved. Stick with it... it's worth it!

text: Used to be wonderful.
review: Used to be wonderful. For many years, my writing setup was Notion on IPad Pro + Magic Keyboard. A magic combo that worked flawlessly until Notion screwed it up...In reading many similar stories in the reviews here, it seems that the fallout can be tracked to the introduction of AI features...and that rings true. Now, Notion for writing on IPad is not useable. You cannot see what you type. It kills any inspiration and thought you may have had when you opened it. It's the anti-writing tool.

text: BUT I need more colors!
review: Loving it! BUT I need more colors! So far, after only a day of use, I am absolutely loving Notion. HOWEVER, the one thing that I truly wish would be added is the ability to add hex codes for more color options or have a color wheel (preferably both). I have too many things that I want to color code with more than the options available, which is pretty limiting. I don't like when different things are the same color simply because I ran out of options because it ends up getting confusing and ruins the point of the color coding! I want full control over my colors used! If implementing a color wheel and hex codes is too complicated, I would at least appreciate more color options or shades and intensities of the current colors.

text: Notion is NOT okay (updated review).
review: Notion is NOT okay (updated review). The app is incredibly buggy. Transitioning from my laptop to my phone is such a painful experience. The Notion app is riddled with glitches and bugs. For example, when I create a database and add multi-select options, trying to hold down on one of the options to move it (I sometimes switch the options to be in a certain order) causes the page to spazz out of control and start auto-scrolling back to the top and it doesn't stop unless I tap out of the page and reenter. This wasn't an issue before, I could move multi-select options whenever, so why is it happening now? I can't help but feel like the effort put into maintaining the user experience in the desktop version, whilst adding in new features, isn't being applied to the app version, which is very disappointing. Creating a great platform for team communication and personal organization, only to have the app's experience be so glitchy and frustrating, is disheartening. I love Notion and what it has helped me accomplish, but please, take better care of the app. It's a shame to see so many bugs crawling around such a nice app. 😞. UPDATE 8/13/26: I genuinely cannot stand this app anymore. Forget the Ai updates, can you please just make the app usable?! Please?? This is such a horrible experience on both iPhone AND iPad

text: Great app, just really buggy!
review: Great app, just really buggy! I love Notion, I love the various templates I can use and how more organized I feel once I started using Notion—the only problem being... how buggy it is: widgets on phone screen don't work properly; they just keep loading endlessly...Sometimes you can't delete text; it just stays there. You have to select the text and do the cut option just to get rid of it, which is annoying. Sometimes the screen just freezes; have no clue why. I think this app is great. I love Notion, like seriously... it's a game changer, but I feel like I'd love this app much more if it just... wasn't so buggy and sometimes impossible to work with.

text: Good app, extremely laggy on iPhone.
review: Good app, extremely laggy on iPhone. Been using Notion for years, I love the app, and though it takes some time to understand how it all works once you do it's simple and fun to utilize. With that said the app is really really laggy on iPhone. A few issues I've found using Notion on iPhone:. 1. I cannot delete text on the app. Say I select text and press the x button to delete it on my iPhone keyboard, it will not delete. Even if I press x to delete it without selecting the text it won't delete so I have to select and press the 'cut' selection. 2. Certain pages won't load when I try to open them, it'll display the loading icon for awhile and then seemingly crash and close the app. 3. Inserting photos and the page auto-scrolls downwards to the end of the page. Pretty self explanatory, but when I insert photos and then try to move them around the page it'll start auto scrolling to the bottom of the page. 4. The app freezing. Sometimes it just freezes and I have to close the app and reopen it. 5. Accidentally selecting an item (like a divider) and the app won't let me close the menu that pops up after where the 'insert below' option shows up. These are just a few issues I've found while using the app on iPhone. I truly do love the app, I just don't like that these issues are so frequent. (side note: i have deleted and reinstalled the app in the hopes of fixing these glitches, but it doesn't fix them.)

I don't want to custom build everything for mobile when it's already on desktop.

Thank you, Notion!

text: Editors, please respond.
review: Editors, please respond. I love Notion. It's a great app, and I think everyone should have it, it's really good. I do have a problem with it, though: I can't do as much on mobile as I can on desktop. I know desktop is inherently more powerful, but Notion is just so limiting on mobile. I would love it if you could improve the quality of the mobile version. For example, with a simple table, I cannot add a cell, row, or column on mobile; I have to do that on desktop. That's only one example. There are so many things entirely possible that I'd love for mobile to do, but it just can't. I love the app and I'm going to give it 5 stars, but I use mobile 90% of the time and desktop only about 10% of the time. I would really love it if mobile were a lot more powerful. Thank you.

Shame as i only have an iPad for personal work.

text: Best app for students.
review: Best app for students. I saw this app at first and I thought "this looks complex" and honestly it is a bit. But thankfully there's a lot of YouTube tutorials to help you learn and once you're able to figure out how everything works and displays... chefs kiss honestly. I use it for school most of the time and it hasn't failed me once. Claude also works seamlessly with this app and the web version as well. One piece of advice however is to not over complicate your pages. Once you have a nice and flowing OS leave it like that and just continue using it. There is no need to use all the functions available. Devs did an amazing job and I'll recommend this to everyone :)

text: best organization/note taking app for my ADHD - i don't use the AI features.
review: best organization/note taking app for my ADHD - i don't use the AI features. everything is labeled with using AI nowadays but i've never once used it and i don't need to. i struggled with finding an app that helps me organize the chaos in my brain and is ADHD friendly and honestly the customization in notion makes it so fun and easy to keep my stuff organized. i don't just use this app for note taking either. i use it even for logging the books i'm reading, the shows i'm watching, etc. i literally use it to organize anything and everything. i've also never once paid for it and there's sooo much i've done with the app. it takes a bit of a learning curve to understand how to use notion but once you figure it out, it's really easy. i can't recommend it enough.

text: I love Notion...on computer.
review: I love Notion...on computer. Notion is great, but the mobile app is a mess of bugs and inconsistencies. Tapping some modules will cause an unclose-able box to appear that persists even after closing the app. Dragging other modules will open them. Menus needing to be dragged to close is annoying and inconstant. I love Notion, but it's better used on computer.

text: Pretty great until it isn't.
review: Pretty great until it isn't. Generally enjoy notion a lot - it's one of the better note apps out there. The range of features is really good. But - two major problems prevent it from being awesome - you can't upgrade your subscription! I signed up through Apple and now I want to bring on two other people to my "business" subscription. You can't do it!!! I have to wait for my current subscription to expire, a month away, or start a new account and. Transfer everything which loses history and maybe some associations. Not much of a business subscription if you can't more people!!!! The other really really bad thing is app startup time. I open my phone for a morning meeting, go to notion to start AI notes and it just sits there... I'm on WiFi, and the app takes so long to load up it misses the first part of the meeting - often the MOST critical part! These two things take the app from great to something I can't rely on. And if I can't rely on it, then I have to have something else that I can rely on. Really unfortunate. Could be the perfect app - and then isn't.

text: As a student, planner, person of many hobbies and loves research and journaling etc THIS APP IS AMAZING!
review: Best app. As a student, planner, person of many hobbies and loves research and journaling etc THIS APP IS AMAZING! Databases are amazing. Templates are so helpful! I now use the notion calendar and connected it to my google calendar so all of my google calendar events were transferred over. When I add lectures to my calendar, I can open my academic notes for that lecture directly from my calendar! It groups them by module. You can look at them in calendar view or list view. You can order them by name, grade, module, difficulty... etc. I have folders for different hobbies, research topics, lists, book tracker, movie tracker. I even have a grade tracker for university! It takes my grades for all my assessments and modules and years and calculates module grades, year grades, overall degree grade, etc! I also have a journal where I keep journal templates. I have a to do list which is also linked to my calendar! You can use this app for everything. It has replaced and combined my calendar and notes app and Microsoft word! This app has very few limits. I use it for so much!

I have a to do list which is also linked to my calendar! You can use this app for everything. It has replaced and combined my calendar and notes app and Microsoft word! This app has very few limits. I use it for so much!

text: Just what a high schooler needs.
review: Just what a high schooler needs. Before coming to notion I was always getting distracted and I wasn't able to study effectively like I used to do. I used about 7 apps before notion but none of them worked. I looked at the reviews at the description and I just thought they were paid to say those positive things ; but when I actually used the app, I found out that I was completely wrong. The setup is pleasing and easy to use, there is no ads or money needed, and the ai friend helps so effectively that I had to write this review. The best part about the ai is that it doesn't really let you down. Every question I ask it always finds a way to answer me in the most effective way possible. And no, it doesn't actually work like ChatGPT does. I don't t like ai that much and I appreciate originality in my essays and school works, so when I found out that you could instruct it to just act like a friendly app that provides suggestions instead of writing full paragraphs, I knew that this was the perfect app for me.

review: Great structure, but very glitchy to use. The way this app is designed practically for organisation, categorising and colouring etc is amazing. Unfortunately it is incredibly glitchy and broken to use it to the point I've given up. Trying to highlight and copy text often fails to paste, and highlighting more than a sentence causes the visuals to disappear and bug out. Half the time I try to select and delete text, the pressing delete doesn't work. This is the only organisation / writing app that's ever bugged out in me this hard. I really hope these bugs will be fixed one day, because if it weren't for that this app would be super helpful

text: IOS iPad incompatible (I mentioned these issues prior >6mon , with no changes unfortunately ).
review: IOS iPad incompatible (I mentioned these issues prior >6mon , with no changes unfortunately ). If I had not used it in writing notes in Mac already, I would never used it in my iPad cause the app here is disappointing for the following reasons. This app is difficult to use as a note taken in IOS :. - Always lagging. - when I try to type using iPad keyboard I can't see what I am writing cause the page will scroll down every single time. - not apple pencil friendly, text difficult to recognize (when I try to select words[writing and editing using it is something I had long since learned that they will never fix it{). - AI support is not optimum in iPad, whenever I will use it the app will lag and I need to close it and reopen to continue my notes taken. - can not search in the page alone. - I can not change the color of any text , it will immediately lag , and do not apply the color changes. - difficult to move text. Keep in mind I am using a new empty page !!!
